body:
P1-17 PLAN part 1/3
P1-17 PLAN, written BEFORE the code (helper-p117, 14 Nov 2026, main 3d0da9c; everything below is read from the code, not run; this plan supplements the 6 Nov and 14 Nov notes on this item).

THE ONE STATE
* Three raw facts stay raw and never read a presentation: (1) networkKindProvider (the link); (2) networkValidationProvider (Android's "internet found": a point-in-time read, asked FRESH by the state at the moment it decides, never through the strip); (3) the resolver's finding: NEW enum ServerFinding { unknown, answering, silent, anotherServer } in EndpointResolver, one field instead of the pair _reachable/_knownDown. anotherServerAtProvider stays raw (the host in "Another server answers at <host>").
* The derived state: enum ServerReachability { unknown, ok, offline, serverAway, wrongServer } in lib/domain (pure Dart, so playback/ may import it), `isAway` = offline | serverAway | wrongServer. Pure function: no network -> offline; else finding unknown -> unknown, answering -> ok (the internet flag does not matter: a Wi-Fi without internet with the home server answering is ok), anotherServer -> wrongServer, silent -> (internet found == false ? offline : serverAway). A Notifier (serverReachabilityProvider) adds the blink filter: entering an away state waits 4 s unless there is no network at all (at once); leaving, or changing between away states, is at once. This is today's ConnectionProblemNotifier + serverAwayProvider moved into one place, Jam removed.
* Why an enum and not "encoreAway | musicAway | noInternet | detecting": the address probe is the Encore door's signed /info. Whether the MUSIC server answers is not something the app can probe on its own: it shows only when Subsonic calls fail (scan status, browse, covers), and P2-20 removes those calls. A "musicAway" member would be a twelfth notion that dies with P2-20. B-77's demand ("the Encore server answers" apart from "the music server answers") is met where the two were confused: the sync engine. "detecting" belongs to the SERVER KIND family (detecting | plain | encore), not to reachability.
* The strip is a presenter over the state (its 5 s shown, 10 s recovered, the cross); ConnectionProblem and connectionProblemProvider are deleted; jamReconnecting leaves the core (the Jam screen shows its own reconnecting, jam_screen.dart:166; a person will notice that the strip no longer says "Reconnecting to the Jam", CHANGELOG line; the two Jam tests of connection_test.dart go with the removed state, they are not weakened).
* AwayCause / awayCauseProvider keep their names and signatures and become reads of the state (offline -> noInternet; serverAway | wrongServer -> serverSilent): the rule "no internet found is connect, a silent server with internet is your server" is written once (it was in the strip, in the player's _notDownloadedWords and in awayCauseProvider).

DECISIONS THE NOTES LEFT OPEN (each with the alternative)
 D1 invalidate() (a network change) sets the finding to unknown. Why: a fact about the old network says nothing about the new one; this is the rule the resolver already applied for the player (_knownDown reset) and for another-server; now every reader follows it. Alternative: keep the finding across the change (no un-grey of rows while the server stays dead after a network switch) but then the first tap after a switch is refused by the player's 5 s negative memo (ReachLook) without a look, where today it is tried. Cost of the chosen one: after a network change DURING an outage, grey rows turn normal for the race time + the 4 s blink filter (about 5 to 8 s) and grey again if the server is still silent. Pinned by a test; docs/31 CN-4b wording updated.
